sentences.text: Lisinopril is used to treat high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Lowering blood pressure lowers the risk of fatal and non-fatal cardiovascular events, primarily strokes and myocardial infarctions.

sentences.text: It also helps with the signs and symptoms of heart failure.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated to reduce signs and symptoms of systolic heart failure

sentences.text: It can also be used for certain patients soon after a heart attack.
sentences.quote: Lisinopril tablets, USP, are indicated for the reduction of mortality in treatment of hemodynamically stable patients within 24 hours of acute myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: The doctor will adjust the amount of this medicine based on how blood pressure responds.
sentences.quote: Dosage should be adjusted according to blood pressure response.

sentences.text: Ask the doctor before using salt substitutes that have potassium.
sentences.quote: Tell patients not to use salt substitutes containing potassium without consulting their physician.

sentences.text: Heavy sweating, dehydration, vomiting, or diarrhea can make blood pressure drop too low.
sentences.quote: Tell patients that excessive perspiration and dehydration may lead to an excessive fall in blood pressure because of reduction in fluid volume.

sentences.text: In people treated for high blood pressure, common side effects are headache, dizziness, and cough.
sentences.quote: Hypertension: headache, dizziness and cough (6.1)

sentences.text: Let the doctor know about any light-headedness, especially in the first few days of treatment.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report light-headedness especially during the first few days of therapy.

sentences.text: Some people may feel tired or weak, or have stomach and bowel changes like constipation or diarrhea.
sentences.quote: Digestive : Pancreatitis, constipation, flatulence, dry mouth, diarrhea.

sentences.text: This medicine can seriously harm an unborn baby, so pregnancy is an important concern.
sentences.quote: Drugs that act directly on the renin-angiotensin system can cause injury and death to the developing fetus

sentences.text: Tell the doctor right away about swelling of the face, lips, or tongue, or trouble swallowing or breathing.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report immediately any signs or symptoms suggesting angioedema (swelling of face, extremities, eyes, lips, tongue, difficulty in swallowing or breathing)

sentences.text: Tell the doctor quickly about signs of infection, like a sore throat or fever.
sentences.quote: Tell patients to report promptly any indication of infection (e.g., sore throat, fever), which may be a sign of leukopenia/neutropenia.

sentences.text: Some older people may be more sensitive to this medicine.
sentences.quote: greater sensitivity of some older individuals cannot be ruled out.

sentences.text: This medicine is used to treat serious heart failure.
sentences.quote: The treatment of NYHA Class III-IV heart failure and reduced ejection fraction to increase survival, manage edema, and to reduce the need for hospitalization for heart failure

sentences.text: It can be added to other medicines to help lower high blood pressure.
sentences.quote: Use as an add-on therapy for the treatment of hypertension, to lower blood pressure.

sentences.text: It is also used for swelling in some adults with liver disease.
sentences.quote: The management of edema in adult patients who are cirrhotic when edema is not responsive to fluid and sodium restrictions

sentences.text: The tablets can be taken with or without food.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone tablets can be taken with or without food, but should be taken consistently with respect to food

sentences.text: Whichever way you choose, take them the same way each time.
sentences.quote: should be taken consistently with respect to food

sentences.text: Stay away from potassium supplements and foods high in potassium, including salt substitutes.
sentences.quote: should be advised to avoid potassium supplements and foods containing high levels of potassium, including salt substitutes.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is breast enlargement.
sentences.quote: The most common adverse reaction with spironolactone treatment is gynecomastia

sentences.text: Stomach problems can happen, such as nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
sentences.quote: Digestive: Gastric bleeding, ulceration, gastritis, diarrhea and cramping, nausea, vomiting.

sentences.text: Some people may feel dizzy, sleepy or confused, or get a headache.
sentences.quote: Nervous system/psychiatric: Lethargy, mental confusion, ataxia, dizziness, headache, drowsiness.

sentences.text: Some people have also had leg cramps.
sentences.quote: Musculoskeletal : Leg cramps.

sentences.text: This medicine can raise the potassium level in the blood.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone can cause hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: Losing too much fluid can cause dehydration, low blood pressure and worse kidney function.
sentences.quote: Excessive diuresis may cause symptomatic dehydration, hypotension and worsening renal function

sentences.text: It should not be used by people who have high potassium or Addison's disease, or who take eplerenone.
sentences.quote: Spironolactone is contraindicated in the patients with: Hyperkalemia Addison’s disease Concomitant use of eplerenone

sentences.text: Older adults are more likely to have weaker kidneys, so their kidney function should be checked.
sentences.quote: Because elderly patients are more likely to have decreased renal function, monitor renal function.

sentences.text: This medicine helps prevent and treat blood clots in the veins and lungs.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of venous thrombosis and its extension, pulmonary embolism (PE).

sentences.text: It also helps prevent clot problems linked to atrial fibrillation or a heart valve replacement.
sentences.quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of thromboembolic complications associated with atrial fibrillation (AF) and/or cardiac valve replacement.

sentences.text: After a heart attack, it helps lower the risk of death, another heart attack, and clots such as stroke.
sentences.quote: Reduction in the risk of death, recurrent myocardial infarction (MI), and thromboembolic events such as stroke or systemic embolization after myocardial infarction.

sentences.text: Take it exactly as prescribed.
sentences.quote: Take warfarin sodium exactly as prescribed.

sentences.text: If a dose is missed, take it as soon as you can that same day, but do not take a double dose the next day.
sentences.quote: If the prescribed dose of warfarin sodium is missed, take the dose as soon as possible on the same day but do not take a double dose of warfarin sodium the next day to make up for missed doses

sentences.text: Regular blood tests are needed to see how well the medicine is working.
sentences.quote: Get your regular blood test to check for your response to warfarin sodium

sentences.text: Eating a normal, balanced diet helps keep the amount of vitamin K you get steady.
sentences.quote: Eat a normal, balanced diet to maintain a consistent intake of vitamin K.

sentences.text: The most common side effect is bleeding, and it can be serious.
sentences.quote: Most common adverse reactions to warfarin sodium are fatal and nonfatal hemorrhage from any tissue or organ.

sentences.text: Signs of bleeding can include nosebleeds, bleeding gums, unusual bruising, dark urine, and black stools.
sentences.quote: nosebleeds, bleeding of gums from brushing, unusual bleeding or bruising, red or dark brown urine, red or tar black stools, headache, dizziness, or weakness

sentences.text: Stomach problems can also happen, like nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and bloating.
sentences.quote: Gastrointestinal disorders: nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, taste perversion, abdominal pain, flatulence, bloating

sentences.text: This medicine can cause major bleeding that may lead to death.
sentences.quote: Warfarin sodium can cause major or fatal bleeding

sentences.text: Tell the doctor right away about any unusual bleeding or symptoms.
sentences.quote: Notify their physician immediately if any unusual bleeding or symptoms occur.

sentences.text: Avoid activities or sports that could cause an injury.
sentences.quote: Avoid any activity or sport that may result in traumatic injury

sentences.text: Older people may need closer checks for bleeding.
sentences.quote: Conduct more frequent monitoring for bleeding with administration of warfarin sodium to elderly patients in any situation or with any physical condition where added risk of hemorrhage is present.

sentences.text: Sertraline is used to treat depression, OCD, panic disorder, PTSD, social anxiety and PMDD.
sentences.quote: Major depressive disorder (MDD) Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) Panic disorder (PD) Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) Social anxiety disorder (SAD) Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD)

sentences.text: It is part of a group of medicines called SSRIs.
sentences.quote: Sertraline hydrochloride tablets are a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor (SSRI) indicated for the treatment of

sentences.text: The label says not to stop sertraline all at once, and to talk with the healthcare provider about lowering it slowly.
sentences.quote: Advise patients not to abruptly discontinue sertraline hydrochloride and to discuss any tapering regimen with their healthcare provider.

sentences.text: When this medicine is stopped, the dose should be lowered slowly whenever possible.
sentences.quote: Gradually reduce the dosage rather than stopping sertraline hydrochloride tablets abruptly whenever possible.

sentences.text: The Medication Guide says to talk with the healthcare provider before stopping this medicine.
sentences.quote: Do not stop sertraline hydrochloride tablets without first talking to your healthcare provider.

sentences.text: Let the healthcare provider know about any prescription or over-the-counter medicines that raise the risk of bleeding.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to inform their health care providers if they are taking or planning to take any prescription or over-the-counter medications that increase the risk of bleeding

sentences.text: Common side effects include nausea, loose stools, shaking (tremor), upset stomach, less appetite, sweating and lower sex drive.
sentences.quote: nausea, diarrhea/loose stool, tremor, dyspepsia, decreased appetite, hyperhidrosis, ejaculation failure, and decreased libido

sentences.text: Sertraline may cause sexual problems in both men and women.
sentences.quote: Advise patients that use of sertraline hydrochloride may cause symptoms of sexual dysfunction in both male and female patients.

sentences.text: Stopping it too fast may cause anxiety, irritability, mood changes, restlessness or changes in sleep.
sentences.quote: Stopping sertraline hydrochloride tablets too quickly may cause serious symptoms including: anxiety, irritability, high or low mood, feeling restless or changes in sleep habits

sentences.text: Let the healthcare provider know if there are signs of an allergic reaction, such as rash, hives, swelling or trouble breathing.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to notify their healthcare provider if they develop an allergic reaction such as rash, hives, swelling, or difficulty breathing

sentences.text: Family should watch for thoughts of suicide or mood changes, especially early on and when the dose changes, and tell the provider about them.
sentences.quote: Advise patients and caregivers to look for the emergence of suicidality, especially early during treatment and when the dosage is adjusted up or down, and instruct them to report such symptoms to the healthcare provider

sentences.text: If signs of serotonin syndrome appear, contact the provider or go to the emergency room.
sentences.quote: Patients should contact their health care provider or report to the emergency room if they experience signs or symptoms of serotonin syndrome

sentences.text: Aspirin, NSAIDs, warfarin and other blood thinners may raise the risk of bleeding with sertraline.
sentences.quote: Concomitant use of aspirin, nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs), other antiplatelet drugs, warfarin, and other anticoagulants may add to this risk.

sentences.text: With this type of medicine, older adults may have a higher risk of low sodium in the blood.
sentences.quote: SNRIs and SSRIs, including sertraline hydrochloride, have been associated with cases of clinically significant hyponatremia in elderly patients, who may be at greater risk for this adverse reaction

sentences.text: This medicine helps control blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
sentences.quote: to improve glycemic control in adults and pediatric patients 10 years of age and older with type 2 diabetes mellitus

sentences.text: It is used along with diet and exercise.
sentences.quote: Metformin hydrochloride tablets are indicated as an adjunct to diet and exercise to improve glycemic control

sentences.text: Before any surgery or x-ray procedure, tell the doctor about this medicine, because it may need to be paused for a short time.
sentences.quote: Instruct patients to inform their doctor that they are taking metformin hydrochloride tablets prior to any surgical or radiological procedure, as temporary discontinuation may be required

sentences.text: The label warns against drinking too much alcohol while taking this medicine.
sentences.quote: Counsel patients against excessive alcohol intake and inform patients about importance of regular testing of renal function while receiving metformin hydrochloride tablets.

sentences.text: The most common side effects are stomach problems, such as diarrhea, nausea, and vomiting.
sentences.quote: the most common adverse reactions (> 5.0%) are diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache.

sentences.text: Weakness (asthenia) and headache can also happen.
sentences.quote: diarrhea, nausea/vomiting, flatulence, asthenia, indigestion, abdominal discomfort, and headache.

sentences.text: In some people, it may lower vitamin B12 levels.
sentences.quote: a decrease to subnormal levels of previously normal serum vitamin B 12 levels was observed in approximately 7% of patients.

sentences.text: Metformin can cause a serious problem called lactic acidosis, which has led to death in some cases.
sentences.quote: Postmarketing cases of metformin-associated lactic acidosis have resulted in death, hypothermia, hypotension, and resistant bradyarrhythmias.

sentences.text: The label says to stop the medicine and tell the healthcare provider right away if you have unexplained fast breathing, muscle pain, a general unwell feeling, or unusual sleepiness.
sentences.quote: Advise patients to discontinue metformin hydrochloride tablets immediately and to promptly notify their healthcare provider if unexplained hyperventilation, myalgias, malaise, unusual somnolence or other nonspecific symptoms occur.

sentences.text: People with severe kidney problems should not take this medicine.
sentences.quote: Metformin hydrochloride tablets are contraindicated in patients with: Severe renal impairment (eGFR below 30 mL/min/1.73 m 2 )

sentences.text: Older adults have a higher risk of lactic acidosis, so their kidneys should be checked more often.
sentences.quote: Assess renal function more frequently in elderly patients

sentences.text: The lisinopril label says that using it with diabetes medicines may increase their blood-sugar-lowering effect and risk low blood sugar.
sentences.quote: Concomitant administration of lisinopril and antidiabetic medicines (insulins, oral hypoglycemic agents) may cause an increased blood-glucose-lowering effect with risk of hypoglycemia.

sentences.text: The lisinopril label says potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone can raise the risk of high potassium.
sentences.quote: Potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, amiloride, triamterene, and others) can increase the risk of hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: The spironolactone label says drugs that raise potassium, including ACE inhibitors, may lead to severe high potassium when used with it.
sentences.quote: Concomitant administration of spironolactone with potassium supplementation or drugs that can increase potassium may lead to severe hyperkalemia.

sentences.text: The label lists ACE inhibitors as examples of drugs that can increase potassium.
sentences.quote: Examples of drugs that can increase potassium include: ACE inhibitors

sentences.text: The sertraline label names warfarin as an example of a protein-bound drug and says to monitor for adverse reactions when used together.
sentences.quote: Protein-bound drugs: Monitor for adverse reactions and reduce dosage of sertraline hydrochloride or other protein-bound drugs (e.g., warfarin) as warranted.

sentences.text: The warfarin label says bleeding risk is higher when warfarin is used with certain other drugs, and it lists sertraline among them.
sentences.quote: Because bleeding risk is increased when these drugs are used concomitantly with warfarin, closely monitor patients receiving any such drug with warfarin.

sentences.text: Sertraline appears in the label's table under serotonin reuptake inhibitors.
sentences.quote: Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors citalopram, desvenlafaxine, duloxetine, escitalopram, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, milnacipran, paroxetine, sertraline, venlafaxine, vilazodone
